lines.text: طالع پس عاشر پس سابع پس رابع پس حادي عشر پس خامس پس تاسع پس ثالث پس ثاني پس
lines.en: the ascendant, then the tenth, then the seventh, then the fourth, then the eleventh, then the fifth, then the ninth, then the third, then the second, then

lines.text: ثامن پس سادس و اضعف جميع بيوت بيت ثاني عشر است که هم زايل ساقط است از طالع و
lines.en: the eighth, then the sixth. And the weakest of all houses is the twelfth house, which is both declining and cadent from the ascendant, and

lines.text: هم اقرب باو و بعضي بيت سادس و ثاني عشر را فقط بيت ادبار گويند و هر خانه که عدد
lines.en: also closest to it. And some call the sixth and twelfth houses only the houses of decline. And every house whose number

lines.text: او فرد باشد انخانه را مذکر دانند و هر چه عدد آن زوج مؤنث و باز ایندوازده خانه را بچهار
lines.en: is odd, they consider that house masculine, and whatever its number is even, feminine. And again, they divide the twelve houses into four

lines.text: ربع منقسم سازند و از انجمله انربع را که میان مرکز عاشر و طالعست و همچنین انرا که میانه مرکز
lines.en: quadrants. And among them, the quadrant that is between the center of the tenth and the ascendant, and likewise the one that is between the center of

lines.text: رابع و سابع است ربع منقبل و ربع مذکر و انربع را که میانه طالع و رابعست و همچنین انرا
lines.en: the fourth and the seventh, is the advancing quadrant and the masculine quadrant. And the quadrant that is between the ascendant and the fourth, and likewise the one

lines.text: که میانه سابع و عاشر است ربع مدبر و ربع مؤنث گویند و آن نصف که میانه مرکز رابع و
lines.en: that is between the seventh and the tenth, they call the retreating quadrant and the feminine quadrant. And that half which is between the center of the fourth and

lines.text: عاشر است از طرف غرب نصف هابط و چون اتفاق افتد که برج عاشر بحسب عدد برج
lines.en: the tenth from the western side is the descending half. And when it happens that the tenth sign, according to the number of the sign,

lines.text: یازدهم طالع بود اوتاد آن طالع را اوتاد مایله گویند چه هر یک در انتقال به بیت مایل
lines.en: is the eleventh of the ascendant, they call the angles of that ascendant the inclined angles, because each one in transition to an inclined house

lines.text: خود اشتمال نمایند و اگر عاشر بحسب عدد برج نهم طالع باشد اوتاد آن طالع را اوتاد زایله
lines.en: includes itself. And if the tenth, according to the number of the sign, is the ninth of the ascendant, they call the angles of that ascendant the declining angles,

lines.text: گویند زیرا که هر یک بیکی از بیوت زایل انتقال کند و اگر برج عاشر بعینه برج دهم
lines.en: because each one transitions to one of the declining houses. And if the tenth sign is exactly the tenth sign

lines.text: طالع باشد اوتاد انطالع را اوتاد قایمه خوانند و قسم ثالث افضلست از قسم اول و قسم
lines.en: of the ascendant, they call the angles of that ascendant the upright angles. And the third kind is better than the first kind, and the first kind

lines.text: اول از ثاني و حد هر خانه بیشی از مبداء آن خانه باشد بپنج درجه تا پنج درجه قبل از مبداء
lines.en: than the second. And the limit of each house is more than the beginning of that house by five degrees, up to five degrees before the beginning

lines.text: بیت ثاني انخانه پس اگر درجه تقویم کوکبي مثلا پیش از مبداء انخانه باشد بدو درجه خانه مقدم
lines.en: of the second house of that house. So if the degree of the ephemeris of a planet, for example, is before the beginning of that house by two degrees, the preceding house

lines.text: او را محل الکوکب بدانند بلکه همان خانه را محل آن اعتبار کنند هر چند في الحقیقه در انخانه
lines.en: is considered the place of the planet, but rather they consider that same house as its place, although in reality it is not in that house.

lines.text: نباشد و این اعتبار بسبب انست که تا ممکن باشد شمس در شب سابع و در روز بطالع در آید ا
lines.en: And this consideration is because, as much as possible, the sun should enter the seventh at night and the ascendant during the day.

lines.text: انیت بیان انواع بیوت اثنی عشریه اکنون در مدلولات هر یک شروع نموده میفرماید
lines.en: This is the explanation of the types of the twelve houses. Now, beginning with the significations of each one, he says:

lines.text: مدلولات بیوت اولا چون طالع مبداء ظهور و وجود اشیاست و دلیل بقاي آن
lines.en: The significations of the houses. First, since the ascendant is the beginning of the appearance and existence of things, and the indicator of their survival,

lines.text: امور که بظهور او ظاهر شده و ایضا طلوع اندالست بر تکون هر متکون و مؤثر در آن خصوصا
lines.en: the matters that have appeared with its appearance, and also its rising is an indicator of the formation of every formed thing, and effective in it, especially

summary.headline: Types and Significations of Houses
summary.text: Classification of the twelve astrological houses by strength, gender, quadrants, halves, and angle types, including inclined, declining, and upright angles. The text then begins the significations of the houses, identifying the ascendant with appearance, existence, and survival.
